s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia
key_facts: 50-year-old man
Known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray–white
Near–complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor is in close contact with peripheral nerves, with positive S100 and negative pan-cytokeratin, EMA, and other epithelial markers

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and multiple cutaneous neurofibromas, with a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation in the superficial bladder wall

shortlist.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows a dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia and frequent mitoses

shortlist.label: Malignant triton tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor shows a mixture of spindle cell and rhabdomyoblastic differentiation, with positive S100 and neurofilaments

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells are positive for S100 and CD56, and negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, and other epithelial markers, with a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation

raw.rationale: The tumor's positive staining for S100 and neurofilaments, along with its association with neurofibromatosis type 1 and the presence of spindle cell proliferation, are characteristic of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: While the patient has neurofibromatosis type 1, the tumor's histology and immunohistochemical profile suggest a more malignant process than a plexiform neurofibroma.

rejected.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: This term is sometimes used interchangeably with malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, but the specific diagnosis of neurofibrosarcoma is not as commonly used in current pathology practice.

rejected.label: Malignant triton tumor
rejected.why: Malignant triton tumors are a subtype of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors that contain rhabdomyosarcomatous elements, but the provided immunohistochemical results do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor cells were negative for desmin and myogenin.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: While schwannomas can express S100, the presence of significant cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern are not typical of benign schwannomas.
